info.title: Chart Retrieval API
info.description:
In order to use this api, we require each request gets sent with an api key in the named header, "x-api-key".

We impose a rate limit for the whole api. If the rate limit is reached, the client will receive the response, "HTTP 429 Too Many Requests".

get.description: Get the status of the specified patient chart request

parameters.name: moxeRequestId
parameters.description: The moxeRequestId provided by us when the patient-chart-request in question was created

200.description: Successfully determined the status of the given request

401.description: The user or app initiating the request was not authenticated. Reauthenticate and try again.

404.description: A patient chart request with the given moxeRequestId could not be found. This means that either you are not authorized to access the request or it does not exist.

429.description: Too many requests. API rate limit reached.

500.description: The request was valid, but an unexpected error occured on the server

requestId.description: The request ID initially provided when the request was initiated

moxeRequestId.description: The unique identifier of this request within Moxe's system

requestStatusCode.description: A code representing the current status of the request

requestStatusDescription.description: A human-readable description of the status of the request, which correspends to the requestStatusCode

requestStatusDateTime.description: The timestamp of when the request entered into the reported status
